title.narrative: Honduras Transportation and Freight Logistics Sector Reform Program III
Programa de Reformas del Sector Transporte y Logstica de Carga de Honduras III

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a la mejora del desempeo logstico de Honduras a travs de reformas sectoriales en los mbitos regulatorio, institucional, de planificacin y de facilitacin comercial, que permita ganancias en la competitividad e integracin regional. La presente operacin es la ltima de una serie de tres operaciones bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP).

The program aims to support improvements in Honduras's logistics performance through regulatory, institutional, planning, and trade facilitation reforms in the sector, with a view to boosting competitiveness and regional integration. This is the last in a series of three operations under a programmatic policy-based loan (PBP).
Commitment in 2021-09-15
Disbursement in first quarter of 2022
